notes.title: A Plunge into Darkness now with cards and achievements!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6842143/f43b40e9234da5e40e61a35c79091a869dde632a.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/615700/A_Plunge_into_Darkness/

Our horror tale has seen growing popularity among players and now comes with the following features:
[list]
[*] Steam Trading Cards
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Cloud
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: The Deal RPG Update!
notes.content:
Achievements are here!
If you are already eligible for any previous achievements and you don't feel like restarting your game, just go to your Camp and interact with the pillar next to you. All the achievements that you should have gotten, will be awarded to you!
Special thanks to SimProseStudios for helping out with this matter. 

Check their awesome game Cavern of Time here: 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/578830/

Faster combat!
When in battle, have the Action key pressed (either Enter or Z by default) and the battle animations will be 2X faster!

Alternative ending revamp! An alternative boss is waiting for you as the last battle if you manage to find how to unlock it! There are clues throughout the game!
